items: PROCESSOR - Celeron J4125 Processor (4 Cores, 4 Threads, 4MB L3 Cache, TDP 6W, 2.0GHz Base Frequency, Up to 2.7 GHz Turbo Frequency).
DISPLAY - 12.3-inch diagonal, WQHD (3000 x 2000) 3K high-resolution IPS touchscreen, micro-edge, 300 nits, 100% sRGB, delicate colors, and every detail is clearly visible.

MASS STORAGE - 8GB LPDDR4 and 256GB SSD smoothly runs multiple applications and browser tabs at the same time for efficient multitasking, providing plenty of storage space so you can access them quickly and easily.
TECH SPECS - Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) | Bluetooth 4.2 | 2MP Front Camera | Full-functional Type-C ports x 2 | 3.5 mm Headphone Jack, 3500mAh lithium battery, up to 8.5 hours of unplugged use.

LIGHTWEIGHT & PORTABLE 2-IN-1 DESIGN - VGKE 2-in-1 touchscreen laptop and tablet weighs only 1.7 lbs/10.8*7.8*0.36 inches, making it an ideal choice for daily work, business or student laptops! A new user interface, more window layout options, and better multi-monitor capabilities bring an excellent user experience.
